helper_window.clear_ask: Clear this chat with Helper? Yes / No
helper_window.what_clear_does: Removes Helper's lines and the person's messages in Helper's window. Kept answers (name, work, set-up answers) and the person's marks stay; those are cleared in Helper's own settings (See what I keep).
helper_window.added: loom-fixes-v1 (11 Nov, his Loom 0:43 and 3:13; Lead's decisions from his words, his to overrule on screen)

rules.tile: Number, then the word: bots_one when the number is 1, else bots. Same for skills and plugins. So: 1 bot, 2 bots, 1 skill, 39 skills, 1 plugin on in this bot, 2 plugins on in this bot.
rules.plugins_number: Plugins switched on for the bot the app has open, plus 1 for Helper. A plugin that is installed but switched off is not counted (Lead, 11 Nov; his words: "We have active plugins").
rules.last_used: 0 days: last_used_today. 1 day: last_used_one. 2 or more: last_used_n with the number. Never '1 days ago'.
rules.all_done: Shown only when all 10 stops are done. The 10 is written in the sentence: if the path changes, this sentence changes with it.
rules.count: {n} of {total} gives '4 of 10'. total is every stop on the path (10). It stands beside the title 'Set up', so it needs no more words.
rules.count_was_loom: {n} of {total} gives '2 of 6'. It stands beside the title 'Set up', so it needs no more words.
rules.all_done_was_loom: Shown only when all six counted stops are done. The 6 is written in the sentence: if the number of counted stops changes, this sentence changes with it.
rules.marks: An opened stop with marked_by person (dash-setup-list-v2.json) shows person_note in grey under its steps, and one button: mark_done while not marked, mark_undo once marked. A stop with marked_by page shows neither: it fills by itself.

plugins_label.note: Recommended. Says switched on, and says it is this bot's. 22 letters.
Shortest, 17 letters, for a narrow tile. Does not say switched on.

activity_title.note: Recommended. Same two words, 'this bot', as the plugins tile.

variants.not_used: The bot's own name in the label ('plugins on in work'). Not offered: Hermes showed the main bot's row as 'Hermes' (hhtech-dash-reads2.md line 70), so the label would read 'plugins on in Hermes', which says the whole Hermes.

fit_risks: The plugins label is 22 letters where the stand-in had 7. At a 480 px left side a tile is about 150 px wide: it may wrap to two lines. For hhdesign and the Builder: let it wrap, or use variant 3 at the narrow size.
'This bot's activity' is drawn in Hermes's small capitals: THIS BOT'S ACTIVITY. Not seen.
state_not_known is long for a screen reader after a stop's name: 'Model, Helper could not check this one just now'. Read aloud it is one clear sentence; not tried in a screen reader.

word_reasons.not_built: Was 'Not built yet.', which speaks about us, not about the person. The new line promises nothing and says where to look.
word_reasons.state_not_done: Was 'not done yet'. 'to do' says the same without a 'not'. Screen readers only.
word_reasons.no_heading_about_missing: No word on the tab says something is not set up. The only 'not' on screen is inside an opened small stop: 'so it isn't counted'.
word_reasons.all_done_was_loom: Was 'Everything Helper can see is set up.' Shorter, and matches '6 of 6' beside it. The five small stops still say 'Helper can't see this one, so it isn't counted.' when opened.
word_reasons.person_note: Says the two things he needs: Helper cannot look, and his own word counts. Eleven words, no Hermes term.
word_reasons.mark_buttons: I've done this is the same words as Helper's own pick (I've done this already) without already, which reads oddly on a button. Not done yet says what pressing it makes true.
word_reasons.tabs_was_loom: His picks (BRIEF, 10 Nov second chat: 'Dashboard', 'Learn', 'My setup'). Not changed.

helper_window_sources.hide: user-guide/desktop.md line 234: "offers **Hide** instead of Minimize" (the app's word for putting a pane away while it keeps its content).
helper_window_sources.show: user-guide/desktop.md line 251: "**Show in status bar**" (the app's word for bringing a thing into view). Not seen in the app.
helper_window_sources.clear: reference/slash-commands.md line 40: "| `/clear` | Clear screen and start a new session |" (Hermes's own word for the same act in a chat). Clear chat is that word with chat, so the person knows what is cleared.
helper_window_sources.clear_ask: My wording. The docs say /new asks with a confirmation modal (slash-commands.md line 248) but give no words for it.
